messages:
sam: quick eyes on PR #19888? waiting on mac-e2e flake. rebase window closes 2026-05-05 18:00 PST. can we swap slots or push an exception?

maria: :eyes: i can review in ~30m. do we have a minimal repro or a flaky test id?

chen: CI shows failure in ui-tests::profile-save on mac-11. looks timing-y, maybe a resource contention. queued rerun -> job 6789.

ci-bot: job 6789 triggered by @chen — mac-e2e (rerun) — queued on runner-5.

alex: if mac rerun flaps again, consider landing behind a feature-flag or canary to avoid the freeze window. is this backend-only?

sam: mostly frontend but touches the SDK surface. adding a toggle would be a bit heavy for a last-minute patch.

ryan: release blackout starts 18:30 PST. if we can't land before the 18:00 rebase cutoff, let's push to tomorrow's hotfix at 10:00 PT. prefer not to risk midnight rollbacks.

maria: i'll prioritize the review now, leaving a couple quick comments.

maria: comment: small nit in auth flow, one-line change. if devops agrees, can we land with author-squash + bypass? @release-coordinator

release-coordinator: :hourglass_flowing_sand: ok, prioritizing this. if CI is green by 17:45 PST we'll grant a 15m exception to the rebase window. otherwise move to tomorrow hotfix. pinging @devops-bot to reserve slot.

devops-bot: merge slot reserved for PR #19888 until 17:50 PST. Auto-unreserve at 17:50 if not landed.

chen: /retest --job=6789

ci-bot: job 6789 finished — succeeded ✅

maria: LGTM :shipit: i'll merge once final CI passes and sam rebases.

sam: rebased onto main, pushing now.

ci-bot: post-merge checks in progress...

devops-bot: merge completed at 6129999588 by maria — no rollout issues observed.
